scope: Only new ordinary-idle stage followed by original diagnostic config backup/restore; no live stores or evidence read

findings.detail: New profile lives under external output, shares canonical/data/instance, changes diagnostic/Paper flags. Original config bytes are checked unchanged. Three policy JSONs live under data root; protected selection records their refs/hashes and workflow_authorized=false. No PaperStart is commanded; idle asserts no paper_process_runs and unchanged lifecycle; both coordinators stop and every role STOPPED/reaped is required.

Backup helper before/after calls mode=software with original diagnostic config. This validates installation/receipt/restoration only. Unlike runtime mode/current(), software mode does not load latest selection or require its product_config_hash to equal original diagnostic config. New idle selection therefore cannot by itself invalidate original software observation.

Ordinary archival inventory reads protected history from canonical DB, validates original immutable envelope/hash and source manifest, and explicitly captures three selected policy refs with actual bytes/hash equality. Historical owner retains selected idle config hash and does not compare it to current backup config. Thus original diagnostic backup can archive the idle selection and policy inputs; no whitelist gap is demonstrated.

Backup manifest and database snapshot bind the command original config. This binding is distinct from archived selection original config commitment. All role/instance locks must be acquired; stopped idle coordinator does not change database inventory. Transient process scopes/logs/release observations/managed stop/public observations are excluded intentionally, not restored as authority.

Restored profile is forced cloud=None, diagnostic_only=True, paper_runtime_enabled=False; marker requires reconciliation/reauthorization, inhibits exposure and grants financial_authority=NONE. Copied idle selection remains historical workflow=false; config mismatch plus restore fence prevents it from enabling runtime/admission. Backup helper explicitly requires restored software admission denied and can rebackup inhibited history.

regression_anchor.assertions: Selected refs included; immutable readers use captured DB; restored flags disabled/cloud disconnected; restored selection and receipt equal originals; restored rebackup supported. Source read only, test not executed.

integration_limits: Backup helper currently prerequisites only q/portable/unattended, not ordinary-idle checkpoint. It can succeed independently of ordinary-idle; it must not claim idle stage passed from its own result. For explicit postchain evidence root can bind idle checkpoint identity/original config hash/stopped/reaped without granting it authority. This is evidence-linkage scope, not a demonstrated backup failure.

Four-way file equality includes the new selected policy files via archival inventory. Canonical selected-record equality is not separately asserted by backup helper; existing source regression asserts it. If native postchain claims protected idle selection preservation, add narrowly targeted readonly current-generation/canonical/hash equality across captured/restored stores rather than infer from queue history checks.
This review does not establish actual timing, helper completion, current guard results or native PASS.
